description: You are a satellite anomaly resolution engineer. The INST satellite has reported telemetry limit violations that need investigation. Your task: (1) Open the Limits Monitor tool to see which telemetry items are currently in violation (yellow warning or red critical state), (2) Navigate to the Telemetry Grapher tool using the left sidebar and add the violating temperature item (e.g., INST HEALTH_STATUS TEMP1) to a graph to observe the trend over time, (3) Based on the telemetry trend, navigate to the Command Sender using the left sidebar and send the corrective command 'INST CLEAR' to reset the alarm state -- select target 'INST' and command 'CLEAR', then click 'Send' and confirm the hazardous command dialog by clicking 'Send' again, (4) Return to the Limits Monitor to verify the violation has been acknowledged. The password for OpenC3 is Cosmos2024! if you are prompted to log in.
